baseline_revision.snapshot_policy: Each production UTF-8 source file below is pinned by SHA-256 after CRLF/CR to LF normalization; the dirty-source baseline head must remain an ancestor of the checked revision, and any normalized content change requires a new read-only audit.

authority_note: This baseline separates production-classified inventory from source-absence-reviewed new requirements and planned demos. Manifest-level file and locator proofs do not prove an item: every production_existing item remains unverified until its own authority, positive, failure, disabled/atomicity evidence and exact contract resolve. It contains no real configuration values, credentials, user content, completion state, or release claim.
retirement_policy: explicitly_retired requires an independent RequirementRef authorizing removal, user-approved compatibility handling, and round-trip evidence. R-SET-07 alone is never retirement authority.

symbol_locators: 不会自动降级 OCR；如需改用 OCR 请在 设置 → 模型服务 → 图片理解 切换引擎

settings_shell.failure_policy: Keep the current pane, query, route and focus target; never navigate to an unrelated pane.

providers.authority: settings_get/settings_save + system credential store + provider IPC
providers.failure_policy: Keep the previous persisted provider, credential and receipt; never silently fallback.

image_understanding.failure_policy: Preserve the last explicit selection; a vision-model failure sends no message and returns actionable guidance, and OCR requires an explicit engine switch.

agents_codex.authority: settings adapter + Codex global config IPC
agents_codex.failure_policy: Keep the previous settings and running-task snapshot; never partially apply a compound policy.

subagents.authority: subagent provider receipts + revisioned atomic pool replace
subagents.failure_policy: Reject the whole invalid replacement and keep the persisted prior revision; the production revision-conflict path reloads the latest Host snapshot, while draft recovery is a separate new requirement.

tools_mcp_rtk.authority: execution environment + RTK + MCP Host commands and secure credential store
tools_mcp_rtk.failure_policy: Keep the previous executable configuration and credentials; rollback optimistic toggles.

knowledge.authority: versioned memory, prompt and skill repositories
knowledge.failure_policy: Keep the current scope and draft; never read, import, edit or delete legacy memory.md content.

preferences.failure_policy: Keep the previous preference and real Host state; rollback UI optimism after adapter failure.

diagnostics.failure_policy: Preserve logs and preview; never export before redaction and explicit destination selection.

browser.authority: planned Host Browser runtime manifest, session registry and grant registry
browser.failure_policy: Keep the feature disabled or the last verified runtime; never grant browse or interact capability from Demo-only state.

permissions.authority: planned Host PermissionRisk classifier and scoped grant registry
permissions.failure_policy: Keep exact pending requests and least privilege; never widen read aggregation to write, delete, network or mutation.

security.authority: secure credential stores, build security policy and redacted diagnostics adapters
security.failure_policy: Keep security controls enforced and user data intact; cleanup must fail closed outside the previewed cache scope.

lifecycle.authority: planned Host CloseGate, persisted close preference and restore adapter
lifecycle.failure_policy: Keep the main window reachable; cancel does not persist and hide is rejected without a verified restore surface.

classification_policy.allowed_exclusion: allowed_exclusion requires a source-backed exclusion_reason and an independent RequirementRef; it is never counted as a retained capability.
classification_policy.verification_boundary: Source audit, prototype projection and planned target mapping are design evidence. production_existing requires pinned production source anchors; new_requirement and planned_demo require a pinned-source absence review plus an explicit classification_basis. Production verification remains zero until M5 executes the real SettingsScene -> IPC -> Host -> persistence chain.
